verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports confirm 128GB of unified memory and quad DDR5-8000. One owner runs a 122B-A10B MoE model at Q4 via llama.cpp, and AMD's docs document GPU-only llama.cpp acceleration and Lemonade SDK LLM support. However, users report memory bandwidth as the limiting factor on tokens/sec, which caveats how practical inference is. Missing for 10: first-party published memory capacity and bandwidth specs, a 70B dense quantized throughput benchmark, and evidence that tokens/sec are practical at long contexts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run a large local LLM (70B-class, quantized) on this platform — enough addressable memory and published memory bandwidth to make local inference practical

citations.quote: Strix Halo (the AI Max+ 395) has quad ddr5-8000, both twice the width and more mhz than typical mobile chips.
I've mostly been running QWEN-3.6-35B-A3B at Q8 and QWEN-3.5-122B-A10B at Q4 with Q8 kv-cache on llama.cpp.
With 128GB of unified memory, large models fit into memory, but memory bandwidth quickly becomes the limiting factor
GPU-only acceleration is enabled through llama.cpp.
